platform: Linux x86_64, custom Godot 4.7 runtime from stable 1.6.0; NVIDIA RTX 3090 Ti
limits: Prepared routes and cases; not a full playthrough or Windows/Android run.
Compatibility does not render Godot Decal footprints; rain, cliff, lava and invisibility shader paths were exercised there.

Original invisibility has base power 50 and lowers sight detectability by 0.5; it does not suppress hearing, close peripheral detection, life sense or prior enemy memory. The fresh-approach gameplay failure was not reproduced in the tested native Nalo/guard case.
Silent Step already suppresses hearing in the tested case and draws the original green star above the head; no unsubstantiated gameplay formula change was made.
The reported solo F9 lightning-wall persistence was not reproduced. The real LocalHost/worker quickload control removed the old world and bolt; no claim of a fix.
The public wiki was packaged and tested locally; no deployment, release, tag or push was performed.
Early stealth network fixtures dereferenced the intentionally absent client ScriptVM; the corrected fixture guards it. Those setup failures are excluded from acceptance.
Earlier high-FOV camera checks exposed diagonal navigation cells and a blocked body-centre anchor; the final clearance sweep handles both and includes an ultrawide margin.

native_original.method: Static Ghidra analysis through REA; not execution of the original game
